IC1: The participant has a diagnosis of Parkinson's disease [AND] according to the diagnostic criteria of the UK Parkinson's Disease Society Brain Bank.
IC2: The participant has received a levodopa combination drug for >= 1 month and has either of the following.
IC4: Decreased response [AND] to levodopa combination drugs
IC5: The participant has received a levodopa combination drug without change in the dose regimen.
IC6: The participant is an outpatient of either sex aged >= 30 and < 80 years.
